BL-1403 — The merge-deletion guard never reports a moved path as dropped and never refuses unexemptably: a path whose content survives elsewhere in the merge result is not a deletion, and a refusal is attributed from the incoming side when HEAD's introducer names no ticket - today archiving a raw intake refuses every worktree's merge-up with no message that can clear it
What it solves: No consumer `required_wiring` anchor: the commit-msg hook already calls
the guard (`swarmforge/git-hooks/commit-msg:30`), so any anchor in the
guard would be satisfied by the parcel's own diff - the BL-1235 fail-open
shape. The shell test and the acceptance scenarios exercise the real hook
path, wh…
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. Reported by the documenter (evidence BL-1402-documenter-merge-blocked-20260904.md) and relayed by the coordinator; the specifier's own root drain is what triggers it.
BL-1403 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1403" (or "reject BL-1403 <reason>") to act.
